mapper.update: UPDATE ai_exam_attempts SET score = #{score} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN a.correct = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / (SUM(CASE WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 0.0), 4) END AS accuracy FROM ai_exam_attempts att JOIN ai_exams ex ON ex.id = att.exam_id LEFT JOIN ai_exam_answers a ON a.attempt_id = att.id WHERE att.student_id = #{studentId} AND ex.course_id = #{courseId}
